description: Extracts emails, URLs (trailing punctuation stripped), IPv4 addresses, EVM addresses, transaction hashes, @mentions, #hashtags, prices, ISO/slash dates and phone numbers (dates, IPs and plain numbers are not reported as phones). Input up to 200000 characters; linear-time. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.
name: text.extract
title: Extract entities from text
